chapter.neroruins.expedition_notes.title: Expedition Notes
hook.neroruins.reveal_ruin.placeholder: Expedition Notes: a survey map has been reserved for you. Ruins are not charted yet, so it will be drawn once they are.
hook.neroruins.unlock_log.placeholder: Expedition Notes: a data-log entry has been reserved in your archive. The archive opens once ruins exist.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.first_l: Find a ruin and read one of its data logs. Every expedition starts with a story someone left behind.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.first_v: Somewhere on this server, someone has claimed a ruin vault for the first time.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.plunder: Fifty vaults of a single ruin type have been claimed across this server. The galaxy is being picked clean.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.puzzle_: Work out a puzzle door and open it yourself.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.relic_h: Bring back three relics from the ruins you explore.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.temple_: Help bring down the last guardian of a temple. Anyone who dealt it damage shares the credit.
quest.neroruins.expedition_notes.vault_c: Open a locked vault inside a ruin.
